input_lp_wiring.rule: Mechanical conversion only: 1->LP1, 2->RP2, 3->LK3, 4->RK4; directions, separators, brackets and parenthetical conditions verbatim. Input-null rows were NOT given invented inputs.
input_lp_wiring.editor_note: The Move List Creator (packages/creation-suite/src/movelist-editor.js) displays inputs through toDisplayInput(), which already renders 1/2/3/4 as LP1/RP2/LK3/RK4; input_lp is the stored LP-form field so bank rows carry correct inputs without a code change. Code gap (reported, not guess-fixed): game/js/moveset-library.js toV2Move() copies entry.input only and does not pass input_lp through, and movelist-editor.js fromMovesetFile() reads move.input (display-converted), not input_lp — so input_lp is currently a stored trace/display field, not a loader-consumed field.
